{{Quote|It would seem that this plot is rather extensive. Our entire fortress is overrun, and I see no means of escape.|Ta'a Chume, during the raid on Reef Fortress|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] hired by [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Yfra]] '''raided''' [[Reef Fortress]] in an attempt to [[Death/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]] of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], [[Ta'a Chume]]. The assassins arrived on the [[Reef Fortress Island|island]] in an [[Assault boat/Legends|assault craft]], cut off all power to the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], and entered by climbing the wall of the stronghold. [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainees]] [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], [[Lowbacca]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who were staying at the fortress, killed several of the Bartokks, rescued Ta'a Chume by helping [[Gender/Legends|her]] climb out the [[Window/Legends|window]] of her [[Sleeper (furniture)|bedchamber]], and fled the island in a small [[Hapan Water Dragon|wavespeeder]]. Jaina [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the wavespeeder into some [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[carnivorous seaweed]], which pulled the assassins, along with their [[Boat/Legends|craft]], into the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. Ta'a Chume then drove the wavespeeder to [[Fountain Palace]], the personal residence of the Hapan [[Queen Mother]], and arrested Yfra.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|We are fine warriors. There is nothing like a physical challenge to make the day more relaxing.''"<br />"''Yeah, we are quite a team, aren't we? Real young Jedi Knights.|Tenel Ka and Jacen Solo, after escaping from some carnivorous seaweed|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], [[Lowbacca]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who were [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainees]] at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] to visit their friend [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], who was recovering from a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] accident that had occurred at the [[Jedi academy|academy]] and left [[Gender/Legends|her]] with only one [[Limb/Legends|arm]]. They stayed at [[Fountain Palace]], the royal residence of the [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]], until a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] [[Bombing of Fountain Palace|went off]] in the dining hall where they were to eat. Because of this danger, the youths were sent to [[Reef Fortress]], a private, isolated sanctuary of the [[Hapan Royal House]], which was located on a small [[Reef Fortress Island|island]] in an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] on Hapes. There, the friends were guarded by [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Yfra]], who was the personal [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of the Hapan [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]] [[Ta'a Chume]], Tenel Ka's [[Parent/Legends|grandmother]], and some [[Hapan Royal Guard|Hapan Honor Guards]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />

Later, Yfra suggested that the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] should take a short trip out on the ocean in a [[Hapan Water Dragon|wavespeeder]]. Unbeknownst to the youths, Yfra programmed the wavespeeder to bring them into an area of dangerous [[carnivorous seaweed]], because she wanted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] them as part of her plot to overtake the Hapan [[Queen/Legends|monarchy]]. However, Tenel Ka, Lowbacca, Jacen, and Jaina escaped from the [[Seaweed/Legends|seaweed]] and manually drove the wavespeeder back to the island. Soon after, Ta'a Chume arrived at Reef Fortress in her royal wavespeeder.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==The raid==
{{Quote|The power to the fortress has been cut off, and our defensive force field no longer functions. The generating station has been destroyed. We are currently under attack by a Bartokk assassin squad.|Tenel Ka, during the invasion of the fortress|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
That [[Standard day/Legends|night]], a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] sent by Yfra invaded Reef Fortress. After arriving in an [[Assault boat/Legends|assault craft]], they cut off all power to the fortress and destroyed the [[Power generator/Legends|generator]] station, disabling the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] in the process. The Bartokks then climbed the wall of the fortress, entered through a [[Window/Legends|window]], and began to attack their primary target, Ta'a Chume. Jacen, Jaina, Lowbacca, and Tenel Ka went to help the matriarch and, after killing several of the assassins, locked themselves and Ta'a Chume in a [[Sleeper (furniture)|bedchamber]] with the Bartokks on the outside. Knowing that the assassins would soon break in the door, the group climbed out the window on a [[Fibercord/Legends|fibercord]] and fled the island in a small wavespeeder. However, they were followed by the assassins in their assault craft.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

Jaina [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the wavespeeder into the [[Dragon's Teeth]], a collection of sharp rocks that stuck out of the ocean, in the hope that the assassins would crash. The assault craft received some damage, and three assassins fell out of it, but it continued to follow the wavespeeder. Jaina then proceeded to drive the wavespeeder into some carnivorous seaweed, expecting the assassins to follow. When they did, Ta'a Chume shot at their craft with a small hand [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] she had, setting it off balance. Because of this, the seaweed pulled the entire craft, along with all the assassins, into the ocean.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|[Yfra will] be given a fair trial, but I think we have more than enough proof&mdash;don't you Tenel Ka?''"<br />"''This is a fact. And I believe I have more than enough proof for something else as well. This adventure has shown me that I am fully recovered from my injuries. I wish to return to Yavin 4.|Ta'a Chume and Tenel Ka|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
Ta'a Chume then drove the wavespeeder to Fountain Palace, where she had Yfra arrested and later put on trial. As a result of the raid and her other adventures at Reef Fortress, Tenel Ka decided she had recovered from her injury and was ready to return to the Jedi academy with her friends.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The raid on Reef Fortress first appeared in the young readers book ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'', written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]], and published in [[1996]].
